value.body: A sports event coordinator plans and runs tournaments, leagues, marathons and school or corporate sports events. Sports management companies, event agencies, academies, leagues and schools hire for this work. A typical day involves scheduling, coordinating venues and vendors, and being on ground during events.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BPES / B.P.Ed, BBA or a sports management course

items.label: Work pattern
items.value: Event-driven, with weekend and on-ground work

items.label: Khelo India Programme budget
items.note: Union budget allocation to the national sports-development scheme

items.label: Khelo India Games held so far
items.note: Youth, University, Para and Winter Games combined

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often start by volunteering or interning at tournaments and marathons, then join a sports management or event company as an operations executive. Knowledge of game rules and officiating helps.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: event manager, league operations manager, sports marketing roles.
Work is seasonal and peaks around event calendars.
Long on-ground days and travel are common.

value.title: B.P.Ed. enrolment
value.note: Bachelor of Physical Education only, based on actual responses; B.P.E. and B.P.E.S. are separate rows not included here.
